items.title: A direct summand of a finite locally free module is finite locally free when the local rings are local
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file modules.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a direct summand of a finite locally free module on a ringed space all of whose local rings are local is again finite locally free (author lemma at source lines 2392-2397, label lemma-direct-summand-of-locally-free-is-locally-free). The proof (source lines 2399-2411) trivialises the ambient module at a point, uses that over a local ring a direct summand of a finite free module is finite free, and then applies the criterion for a finitely presented module with free stalk to obtain freeness of the same rank on a neighbourhood (proof lines 2400-2410). The reduction to the stalk together with the localisation criterion is the content. H2.
